CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 40

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

3. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 7

4. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 17
   C. 19
   D. 7

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 14

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

16. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
